clue.text: Some delay in imposing sentence on convict

indicators.note: on places the sentence word next to the convict word in this across entry

parts.note: a prison sentence is time, as in 'doing time'
a lag is slang for a convict, especially an old one

explanation.surface: A judge takes a while to pass sentence on a prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: A gap of time between cause and effect is a hold-up or interval, a kind of delay.

clue.text: Swell to fortissimo

parts.note: ff is the musical marking for fortissimo, very loud

explanation.surface: Music swells up to a very loud climax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swell' looks like a musical verb, but it is the noun: a fashionable, upper-class person.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal British words for a smartly dressed upper-class gentleman.

clue.text: Identify the victim

definitions.meaning: to pick out or single out something
the target of a swindler or con artist

explanation.definitionFit: To single out is to mark someone, and a con man's chosen target is his mark.

clue.text: Has a cigarette and looks happier

definitions.meaning: starts smoking by putting a match to it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to ignite a smoke and for a face to brighten.

clue.text: Preceding to enter by gate at the front

parts.note: to enter is to go in

indicators.note: at the front picks the opening letter of the word gate

explanation.surface: Someone walks ahead to get in by the front gate.
explanation.definitionFit: Going can mean leaving or departing first, used here as moving on ahead.

clue.text: Coax little Josephine into ruffled lace

indicators.note: into puts the short name inside the rearranged letters
ruffled means disturbed, so the letters of lace are rearranged

parts.note: Jo is a short form of the name Josephine

explanation.surface: A girl is persuaded to wear frilly lace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coax' is the definition; 'little' signals a shortened name, the usual way crosswords give a pet form.
explanation.definitionFit: To coax is to persuade with flattery, a synonym of wheedle.

clue.text: Under treatment, impart personal depression

indicators.note: letters being treated or processed are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: A patient receiving medical care shares their private depression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Under treatment' rearranges IMPART; 'depression' is a hollow in the body, not low spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: The hollow under the shoulder is a body cavity everyone has, a personal hollow.

clue.text: Penitentiary with unlimited accommodation?

parts.note: a jail where inmates are not locked in, read as one with endless room

explanation.definitionFit: A low-security jail lets inmates move freely, as if its space had no walls or limits.

clue.text: One of the fruits of advanced age?

definitions.text: One of the fruits of advanced age?

parts.words: One of the fruits of advanced age?
parts.note: a small dark fruit whose name begins with a word for an older person

explanation.definitionFit: A dark berry of the shrub Sambucus, its name starting with a word meaning older.

clue.text: Solid grasp of company case?

parts.note: a firm is a business company
a grip is an old word for a travelling bag or suitcase

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a business has a strong grip on a legal case.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong, secure clutch on something is a solid grasp.

clue.text: Threaten one politician with death

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
MP is a Member of Parliament
the end is a euphemism for death

explanation.surface: A single politician is menaced with being killed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that looms or is about to happen threatens, as a storm impends.

clue.text: Not a musical score

parts.note: a score taken not as written music but as the number it also means

explanation.definitionFit: A score is a set of twenty, so the number is a score that is not sheet music.

clue.text: The confidence of one taking part

definitions.text: The confidence of one taking part

parts.words: The confidence of one taking part
parts.note: a secret said by an actor playing a role, meant for the audience to hear

explanation.definitionFit: An actor's loud aside, heard by the audience but supposedly not the cast, is a theatrical confidence.

clue.text: The case for the prosecution?

parts.note: a grammatical case, taken as the one suited to someone who accuses

explanation.definitionFit: This is the grammatical case of a direct object, its name echoing the act of accusing.

clue.text: All-star casts?

parts.note: casts as in astrological charts drawn up entirely from the stars

explanation.definitionFit: Astrological forecasts are cast from star positions, so they are casts made wholly of stars.

clue.text: Musical group stepping out together

definitions.meaning: a stage show, here the Broadway show of that name
a row of dancers moving in step behind the principals

explanation.definitionFit: A row of dancers performing in unison; A Chorus Line is also a famous Broadway musical.

clue.text: Cricket side gets lucky cup draw with an extra

parts.note: the leg side is the half of a cricket field behind the batter's legs
a bye lets a team pass to the next round of a cup without playing

explanation.surface: A team is drawn against nobody in the cup and gets something extra.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an extra is a run not scored off the bat; a LEG BYE is one that comes off the batter's body.
explanation.definitionFit: A leg bye is one of the runs in cricket counted as extras, not credited to the batter.

clue.text: There'll be talk if this is broken

definitions.text: There'll be talk if this is broken

parts.words: There'll be talk if this is broken
parts.note: the idiom of starting a conversation by breaking a frozen surface

explanation.definitionFit: To break the ice is to end an awkward silence and get people talking.

clue.text: The kindness of people

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both humane compassion and the human race collectively.

clue.text: Initially thought to come from outer space

definitions.text: Initially thought to come from outer space

parts.words: Initially thought to come from outer space
parts.note: something known by initials and suspected to be alien in origin

explanation.definitionFit: A sighting known by its initials that people believe could be an alien spacecraft.

clue.text: Unfair bit of gossip?

parts.note: unfair read as not fair, the opposite of fair or beautiful

explanation.definitionFit: Nasty hearsay; 'unfair' is reread as not fair-looking, i.e. unattractive.

clue.text: The extent to which undergrads work?

definitions.text: The extent to which undergrads work?

parts.words: The extent to which undergrads work?
parts.note: a word for extent that is also the qualification students study for

explanation.definitionFit: The word means extent, as in 'to some extent', and the qualification students study for.

clue.text: Chap involved with literacy in classical form

indicators.note: involved means tangled together, so the letters of both words are mixed

explanation.surface: A man engaged in reading and writing in the traditional style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' mixes the letters of CHAP and LITERACY together; 'in form' links the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something model or exemplary, the perfect original type, is classic or classical.

clue.text: Two in difficulties, being pulled along

indicators.note: the words in difficulties are in trouble and so thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Two people in trouble have to be towed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'difficulties' rearranges the letters of TWO IN; the surface reads 'in difficulties' as one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle being towed behind another is said to be in tow.

clue.text: Solid figure that may take root

definitions.meaning: a number from which a ... root can be taken

explanation.definitionFit: A six-faced solid shape, and a power that has a root in mathematics.

clue.text: Growth seen on upturned ship's bottom

indicators.note: upturned in a down entry means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: the keel runs along the bottom of a ship's hull

explanation.surface: Something growing is found on the hull of a capsized ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A vegetable is something grown, so a growth in the gardening sense.

clue.text: I am given a role to communicate

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
a part is a role in a play

explanation.surface: An actor is cast in a role in order to get a message across.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass on news or knowledge is to communicate it.

clue.text: One may be struck for showing off

definitions.text: One may be struck for showing off

parts.words: One may be struck for showing off
parts.note: struck as in adopting a pose, not hitting someone

explanation.definitionFit: One strikes a pose or posture to impress, and that pose is called this word.

clue.text: Bearing blossom in March or April

definitions.text: Bearing blossom in March or April

parts.words: Bearing blossom in March or April
parts.note: a compass bearing with a little extra, and the spring festival whose date moves between two months

explanation.definitionFit: The spring festival falls in March or April, and its name looks like 'more east', a bearing.

clue.text: Knew cry comes from a woodpecker

indicators.note: comes from signals the bird's name is made out of these letters

explanation.surface: A known call is produced by a woodpecker.
explanation.definitionFit: The wryneck is a small European bird of the woodpecker family, named for twisting its neck.
